billing_lag_note: Invoiced GPU hours lag well behind actual runtime on 48004205 (0.793 h invoiced against roughly 6.56 h of measured uptime). `vastai show invoices` also returns only the current bucket, so invoiced_to_date is a sum of the buckets observed on 2026-08-18 and 2026-08-20. Budget decisions use accrued_estimate.

accrued_estimate.method: 48004205 GPU 6.56 h * 2.64 + observed storage 13.223 h * 0.1389 + network 0.090; 48178589 invoiced 1.641 + network 0.090; plus instance 48187958 invoiced 0.219 for M2 T1; plus 2 days of stopped-disk on 48178589 (120 GB) and 48187958 (80 GB) at US$2.22/day = US$4.44

stopped_state_note: A stopped instance still bills the 300 GiB disk at US$0.1389/h (about US$3.33/day). Destroying the instance deletes /workspace, so artifacts must be exported first.
